title: デビュー戦の後に・バクシンスタート！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmmm… Mmhm!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I can see it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I can see myself running at a speed like never before, charging down the Bakushin Road!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let us Bakushin with gusto!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: First off, what races shall I compete in to ready myself for the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's me running, so it has to be a G1! The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes? Or perhaps the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't have enough experience to debut in a G1 race yet. For now, she's better off competing in something like…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'd like to hear it!
choice_data_list: Would you like to try running in the Keio Hai Junior Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, 1,400 meters?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But I'd like to make the Satsuki Sho my first Classic race! Wouldn't that be way too short by comparison?!
choice_data_list: Most of the junior-year races are short distance.
Most of the junior-year races are short distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I feel like even 1,400 meters might be too long for Sakura Bakushin O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Guh! But, but—
choice_data_list: As class representative, you must exercise humility.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Humility?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jumping headfirst into G1 races might seem cool, but I'm worried some people might keel over in shock if they see her speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to convince her it would be best to first show up at the Keio Hai Junior Stakes and gradually let everyone get used to her speed…
choice_data_list: Don't you think that's the kinder thing to do?
Don't you think that's the kinder thing to do?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I think…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Understood. Then for the next race, the goal is to let the world at large witness my speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In no time, the crowd will be used to chanting "Whoa, so fast!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One way or another, we decide our next race will be the Keio Hai Junior Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!
